newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian minister sees more rate cuts-paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian minister sees more rate cuts-paper.

text.p: Australian Industry Minister John Moore has said the government expects further cuts in official interest rates, the Australian Financial Review reported on Friday.
The newspaper reported Moore as saying that the government's August 20 budget had taken one percent off interest rates and there was probably more to go.
"The outcomes are already there, you've seen them in the money markets and I think there is more to come in relation to interest rates," Moore told the newspaper.
